restated_task: Add an instance method `Version.is_compatible(other: Version) -> bool` to the `Version` class in `src/semver/version.py`. The method returns True when `other` (the new version) can be used in place of `self` (the old version). Compatibility rules: majors must be equal; new.minor >= old.minor; prerelease parts must be equal (both absent counts as equal); patch is ignored. Major version 0 is special: only identical versions (major, minor, patch, prerelease all equal) are compatible. If `other` is not a `Version` instance (subclasses allowed), raise `TypeError` with message starting with 'Expected a Version type but got ' followed by the type. Include a docstring with at least two doctest examples. Do not modify tests, docs, packaging, or other public behavior; keep existing pytest suite passing.

interface_contract.name: Version.is_compatible
interface_contract.behavior: Returns True when `other` (new version) is compatible with `self` (old version). Compatibility rules: 1) Major versions must be equal. 2) New minor >= old minor. 3) Prerelease parts must be equal (both None counts as equal). 4) Patch version is ignored. 5) If major == 0, versions are compatible only if major, minor, patch, and prerelease are all identical (build metadata is ignored per semver spec). Subclasses of Version are accepted as `other`. Returns boolean.
error_cases: TypeError: raised when `other` is not an instance of Version (or subclass). Message must start with 'Expected a Version type but got ' followed by the type representation (e.g., "<class 'str'>").

acceptance_criteria: Version(0, 1, 0).is_compatible(Version(0, 1, 1)) is False (major 0 requires identical patch)
Version(1, 2, 3).is_compatible('wrongtype') raises TypeError with message starting with 'Expected a Version type but got <class 'str'>'
Version(1, 2, 3).is_compatible({'a': 2}) raises TypeError with message starting with 'Expected a Version type but got <class 'dict'>'
Version(1, 2, 3).is_compatible([]) raises TypeError with message starting with 'Expected a Version type but got <class 'list'>'
class CustomVersion(Version): pass; CustomVersion(1, 0, 0).is_compatible(Version(1, 0, 0)) is True (subclass accepted)
Method docstring contains at least two doctest examples
